name: Furious Flame
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: Religious sigils of Scal carefully carved into the doorframe capture Tokainen's suppressed anger and frustration, unleashing it in a destructive explosion when a creature attempts to open the door.
disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert) to scratch out the religious iconography, DC 24 Religion check (trained) to pray for safe passage, DC 28 Diplomacy check (expert) to soothe the emotions powering the magical ward, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the magical energy

offensiveAbilities.name: Furious Explosion
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the door directly or with a tool; Bypass key

Effect The trap explodes in a 15-foot radius burst, dealing 5d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 26 basic Reflex save). Creatures damaged by the trap must additionally succeed at a DC 26 Will save (against a mental effect), becoming Confused for 1 minute on a failure.
